name: @etzhayyim/shinkansen-rw-free
description: RW-free reference implementation of shinkansen (新幹線 public rail reference: lines + timetables + fares + operation status) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces RW graph). (c) mixed split: public catalog migrates; reserveSeat/searchAvailability + reservation (Tier-3 PII name/payment/seat) + SmartEX/ekinet booking proxies stay etzhayyim via consent-capability. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000 + ADR-0014.
